target_customer: Sunscreen and skincare formulators and brands that license anti-aging UVA protection ingredients
problem: Only two FDA-approved chemical ingredients protect against UVA, and one is neither photostable nor GRASE, while UV causes most skin aging. Lygg developed a patented photostable ingredient to boost UVA protection.
business_model: Ingredient development and licensing to skincare brands (not confirmed by the company site)

founders.name: Graham Dick
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page. Founded Lygg in 2020 after Hawaii banned two common sunscreen ingredients.

technical_complexity.rationale: Inventing a new photostable UV filter requires chemistry research and regulatory safety work in a market where the FDA approved no new filter for about two decades.

defensibility.rationale: The company claims a patent, and any new active ingredient needs lengthy safety testing.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents copying Lygg; a 2026 NPR piece says the FDA approved bemotrizinol, a filter long sold in Europe, as the first new sunscreen filter in over 20 years.

market_need_then: Hawaii banned two sunscreen ingredients (the YC page cites this) and the YC page notes up to 90 percent of skin aging comes from UV light; the page's claim that only two FDA approved chemical UVA filters exist reflects limited options.

branding.domain_note: Uses lygg.com and lyggcorp.com; history not found.

brand_strength.rationale: A B2B ingredient name with a near empty website and no press about the brand; the invented spelling is ambiguous to pronounce.

outcome_analysis: Lygg is a one person YC Winter 2021 company building a UVA filter ingredient. Its website offers a single line and the sources give no verified funding, customers or milestones, so the outcome is unknown. Research-heavy regulatory timelines make slow progress plausible, but no source confirms the reason for the quiet record.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators give a 500K convertible note (CB Insights), a 2023 seed of about 3M, 3.6 EUR M or 3.9M total (Seedtable, Parsers.vc), 1.2M (VCBacked) and 4.2M (FundedIQ); no primary announcement found. Competitor search found only a 2026 regulatory story and undated trade articles; no dated rivals near the batch, so the list is empty. A search summary mentions a 2023 item about sunscreen ingredients from lignin which I could not tie to Lygg. No shutdown or acquisition found. Name origin not found. Completeness pass: the 2023-06 seed of $1.2M is recorded from VCBacked alone; other databases give larger totals (about 3M to 4.2M, Seedtable, Parsers.vc, FundedIQ) that are not summed or recorded. No press found. Unrelated Lignin Industries (Sweden) is a different company.
